gate_r2_01_fixed.closing_state: 本批收尾依据只取 dump 之前最后一条可靠状态行; 必须 state=STOPPING(2) 且 in_flight=0 且 dropped=0 且 records==预期; ACTIVE(1)/IDLE(0) 一律 BATCH_NOT_STOPPING/BATCH_STATE_RECORDS 拒绝
gate_r2_01_fixed.protocol_line_integrity: 头行/数据行/状态行/汇总行逐条核: 行内无 NUL(NUL_IN_PROTOCOL_LINE)、以 LF/CRLF 收尾(PROTOCOL_LINE_UNTERMINATED)、整行锚定匹配且数字后必须紧跟真分隔符 => dropped=0BAD / records=3BAD / dropped=0<NUL> 均判 PROTOCOL_LINE_MALFORMED
gate_r2_01_fixed.frame_boundaries: 块外数值记录/INCOMPLETE => ROW_OUTSIDE_CSV_FRAME; 重复头行 => HEADER_EXACT_MATCH; 重复汇总 => DUMP_TAIL_EXACTLY_ONE; 汇总后的状态行 => STATE_LINE_AFTER_FRAME; 均不得归为普通异步日志
gate_r2_01_fixed.status_entry_cross_check: status 行 entry 与本批不符或 records>0 而 entry='-' => BATCH_STATE_ENTRY
gate_r2_01_fixed.no_stitching: 不拼接不同响应凑成功: 只取最后一条可靠证据, 与之冲突即拒
gate_r2_01_fixed.reject_plan: REJECT 与解析异常(退出码 4)一律 clear=0/next=0; 调用方必须同时核对 rc + JSON verdict + action_plan

gate_r2_02_fixed.i32_range: I32_MIN=-(1<<31), I32_MAX=(1<<31)-1; 三个 i32 列(pwm_raw_rc/permit_write_rc/outcome)各有两边界正控与外侧一值负控
gate_r2_02_fixed.uint32_upper_bounds: gen 改 gen_u32(1..2^32-1); 所有 u32 列含 pre/body_* 一律 <=2^32-1; slot 仍 <64
